subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC trial plan for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC trial plan for Acme Corp

Hi Alice 

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can pick the right PoC path:

Summary of needs (from call):
- Primary goal: evaluate inference latency and cost at 95th pct for our customer support routing model (~1200 tokens/request)
- Data sensitivity: part of the inputs are PII; security/compliance is a gating factor for Prod
- Traffic profile: spiky daytime traffic, expected 50-200 qps during peak after rollout
- Timeline: exec wants a 4-6 week evaluation before vendor decision in Q3

Deployment options we discussed:
1) Hosted API (Redwood hosted) - fastest to start, simple integration, less isolation
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) - predictable throughput, data isolation per tenant, recommended for mid-sized scale trials
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) - required if procurement requires customer-managed network or strict data residency

Success criteria we recommend for the PoC:
- Latency: P95 <= 1200 ms for 1200 token prompts under realistic traffic patterns
- Cost: estimated $/k tokens within 25% of forecasted threshold
- Reliability: 99.5% availability over a 2-week soak period
- Functional: model outputs meet baseline accuracy on your test prompts (we'll use the Eval set you shared)

Proposed PoC plan (attached: acme_poc_plan.pdf):
- Week 0: kickoff & environment selection (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Week 1: integration + sample traffic + baseline measurements
- Weeks 2-3: load profile tests, latency/cost tuning (batching, quantization recommendations)
- Week 4: soak + success criteria validation + handoff notes

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm which deployment mode you prefer for the PoC (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) or whether you want Redwood to recommend one based on security and traffic (we can run a gap analysis).
2) Share the final stakeholder list and the procurement contact (we'll need them for the reserved capacity quote or PO).
3) If possible, upload the security questionnaire - I attached the Redwood template and your questionnaire for quick mapping.

CC'd Marissa (CS) for technical kickoff planning and Jordan for commercial/contract items. If you want, we can schedule a 30m kickoff next week - I have openings Tue/Thu morning PT.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme_poc_plan.pdf, acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Ben - thanks for the clear summary. A few quick answers from our side:

1) Deployment preference: leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the PoC. We want the isolation and predictable throughput for the test, and it aligns better with procurement expectations for reserved usage.
2) Stakeholders:
   - Alice Wong (PM, AI Platform) - primary PoC sponsor
   - Tom Rivera (Infra Eng) - technical lead for integration and networking
   - Priya N. (Security) - will be reviewing SOC2 / questionnaire
3) Procurement contact: contracts@acme-corp.com (I’ll intro shortly)

Timeline: we can do a kickoff the week of June 22; Tom is available Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Security: Priya will review the security questionnaire. We have a couple of non-negotiables around key management (KMS) and network egress logs - if Dedicated doesn’t meet it out of the box, we may need Private. Please flag any gaps.

I attached our completed security questionnaire answers.

Thanks,
Alice
